text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having fought and won through countless 
races alongside Sakura Chiyono O, on this 
very day—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swaying with the rhythm of the train 
alongside Sakura Chiyono O, we were on our 
way to the hot springs won from the 
shopping district lottery.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, our transfer is 7 stations ahead, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please let me know if you get 
sleepy. I'll stay awake in your place.
choice_data_list: Let me know if you get sleepy too.
Let me know if you get sleepy too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No way.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Please let me treat you to some 
hospitality for today, at least.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I even made an itinerary for our trip, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day before our hot spring trip, she 
handed me a small "Hot Spring Trip 
Guidebook."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Written in huge letters on the first page 
was: 'I will give lots of payback to the 
Trainer who took so much care of me.'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what a magnificent appearance...! 
This clearly must be an inn of great 
renown.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And so, please open your guidebooks to 
page 5.
choice_data_list:
"Supposedly used by a certain famous 
Umamusume"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly! And according to our advance 
research...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Apparently neither of the rooms will have 
karaoke this time around...
choice_data_list:
Is that something to be disappointed 
about?

So that's the part you're disappointed 
about, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Because it's fun, isn't it? Partying 
it up after soaking in the hot springs."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Still, since I can't do that, I've been 
practicing magic tricks! Fufu~ I'll show 
them to you whenever you're free!"
choice_data_list: We're fully prepared!
We're fully prepared!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! Well then, please, after you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Sakura Chiyono O pushing me by the 
back, we entered the building. I could 
even feel the immense pressure of her 
absolute determination to play the perfect 
host.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then accepting her feelings right now is 
probably what would make her happiest.
choice_data_list: Well then, I'll go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we headed to the hot springs—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I get out of the bath and wait for Sakura 
Chiyo no O. She had handed me a magazine 
beforehand in case I finished first."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems today is truly a day for 
receiving endless consideration. However, 
I originally came here for another 
purpose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This hot spring trip is also a way to 
reward her for all her hard work up until 
now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Trainer, are you already finished 
for the day?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What is that in your hand?
choice_data_list: Here's your fruit milk.
Here's your fruit milk!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, thank you very much! Thank you 
for being so thoughtful.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hawawa, but please don't worry about it at 
all. Today is the day to treat you, 
Trainer!
choice_data_list: For me, it's a day to pamper you.
For me, it's a day to pamper you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehh~...!? No way, no way.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who's always being looked 
after, so it's not like I've done anything 
to deserve such pampering...
choice_data_list: You've won so many races
You've won so many races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah-wawawa... Ehehe. Well~... you see~...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“I feel like that's all thanks to you, 
Trainer... If anything, I'm the one who 
should be thanking you.”
choice_data_list: They showed us how hard they could work.

You really showed me how hard you can push 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, that's all thanks to you too, 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Because you were the one who taught me how 
to put in that effort, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe... What's with you all of a 
sudden~? Oh, Trainer, you're making me 
blush.
choice_data_list: As your Trainer, I'm so proud of you
You make me so proud as your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wah...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: Thank you, Chiyono O

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehe, ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...The pleasure is mine. Thank you so very 
much.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*... What am I gonna dooo...? It's 
hopeless now...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Please don't look at me right now... It's 
kind of embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... I wasn't expecting to be praised 
today... It kind of threw me off...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The magic trick I prepared was a flop, and 
now I'm just lazing around... And before I 
knew it, I ate all the food...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Uuugh...
choice_data_list:
If you got to take it easy, then that's 
good, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Jeez... Trainer-san, really...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa, no, don't! Please don't look me in 
the eye yet~. It just makes me remember 
what happened earlier~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuuu~... *sigh*...! Geez~... Thank you 
as always~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, she covered her face with her 
hands and spent the rest of the time 
rolling around and around on the tatami 
mats.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Sakura Chiyono 
O...
